paragraphs: First Student moves students to and from school, with a stated mission of the safest, most reliable and most efficient ride. School districts are its partners, in communities big and small.

The company reports more than 48,000 vehicles, including electric buses. It lists over 530 locations across two countries. By its own count, those buses carry 4.8 million student journeys a day. A technology platform called HALO oversees the transportation journey. One piece of it, First View, is a vehicle tracker app for parents and caregivers. Buses can also be rented for events and field trips through a charter quote.

The company says it has provided a safe and reliable experience for nearly half a century. In one award citation it was recognized in a transportation category for HALO's safety tools, predictive maintenance and real-time visibility. A mascot named Safety Dog teaches students about safe school bus behavior. The mascot travels a coast-to-coast, back-to-school tour. Its leadership team spans transportation management, technology and electrification.
